title: Stir Fried Flank Steak with Peppers
description: A classic Chinese dish featuring marinated flank steak, stir-fried with peppers and spices.
instructions: 1. Slice the flank steak into thin strips.
2. In a small bowl, whisk together soy sauce, sesame oil, and sesame seeds.
3. Add the sliced steak to the marinade and mix well.
4. Let the steak marinate for at least 30 minutes.
5. Heat a wok or large skillet over high heat.
6. Add 1 tablespoon of sesame oil to the wok and swirl to coat.
7. Add the sliced onions and bell peppers to the wok and stir-fry for 2-3 minutes.
8. Add the marinated steak to the wok and stir-fry for 3-4 minutes, or until cooked to your liking.
9. Season with salt and pepper to taste.
